headline: Delta Electronics, a Taiwan-listed electronics maker, is working with Nvidia on technology for Level 4 self-driving cars.
score_reason: Announced 29 Sep 2026, so stale for this edition; lowered by 1.
importance_line: No carmaker, product or launch date is named in the coverage we found, so it shows direction rather than cars on the road.
source: Delta Electronics, as relayed by Ad Hoc News
summary: Delta Electronics said in a 29 Sep 2026 release, as relayed by Ad Hoc News, that it will combine its vehicle energy management, electric powertrain, in-car computing and integration work with Nvidia's Hyperion platform and Halos safety system for Level 4 autonomous driving, meaning cars that drive themselves in set conditions. The news is a week old, so this is a follow-up to the original release.
notes: Stock-news page used only for the partnership sentence; Eureka original blocked.
